messages.subject: Error at sumstats:
messages.body_plain:
To all,

I was running the sumstats function and got the following error:

###
Merging file: A.txt with the reference file: reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt
44876107 rows present in the full A.txt summary statistics file.Error in `inner_join()`:
! `...` must be empty.
✖ Problematic arguments:
• all.x = F
• all.y = F
Run `rlang::last_error()` to see where the error occurred.
> rlang::last_error()
<error/rlib_error_dots_nonempty>
Error in `inner_join()`:
! `...` must be empty.
✖ Problematic arguments:
• all.x = F
• all.y = F
---
Backtrace:
 1. GenomicSEM::sumstats(...)
 2. GenomicSEM:::.sumstats_main(...)
 6. dplyr:::inner_join.data.frame(ref, file, by = "SNP", all.x = F, all.y = F)
Run `rlang::last_trace()` to see the full context.
###
My code was as follows:

files<-c("A.txt", "B.txt", "C.txt")
ref= "reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt"
trait.names<-c("A","B","C")
se.logit=c(F,F,F)
linprob=c(F,F,F)
info.filter=.6
maf.filter=0.005
OLS=c(T,T,T)
N=NULL
betas=NULL

INS_sumstats <-sumstats(files=files,ref=ref,trait.names=trait.names,se.logit=se.logit,OLS=OLS,linprob=linprob,N=NULL,betas=NULL,info.filter=info.filter,maf.filter=maf.filter,keep.indel=FALSE,parallel=FALSE,cores=NULL)
###
A, B and C are continuous.

I am not sure why all.=F and all.y=F.   I would appreciate any help you can give me.

Thanks!

Dan

messages.subject: Re: Error at sumstats:
messages.body_plain:
Hi Dan,

Mark Adams also recently raised this and identified the issue as an update to the dplyr package that made the all.x and all.y arguments obsolete for the inner_join function used within sumstats. Those fixes are in if you want to try reinstalling and rerunning.

Best,
  Andrew
